scope.question: Does Shamash IT only build websites?
scope.answer: No. Shamash IT focuses on enterprise software, FinTech platforms, ERP, document management, AI automation, cloud infrastructure, cybersecurity, and managed support. Web and mobile development is part of a broader enterprise capability.

integration.question: Can Shamash IT work with existing systems?
integration.answer: Yes. Integration is a core part of the delivery model. Solutions can connect with ERP, accounting, document, identity, banking, reporting, and cloud systems through secure APIs and workflow design.

financialInstitution.question: Which solution is best for a financial institution?
financialInstitution.answer: Banks, factoring companies, and financial institutions should start with Xpert Factor, the platform focused on factoring, financing workflows, credit risk, collections, accounting, and reporting.

support.question: Can the team support a platform after launch?
support.answer: Yes. Shamash IT provides managed IT, maintenance, monitoring, incident response, technical support, and long-term platform evolution.
